name: Nivon – Free AI Chatbot and Agent for Customer Support
author: Nivon AI

sections.description:
🤖 Give your customers instant answers with Nivon.

Nivon is an AI-powered customer support chatbot that you train on your own website content, documentation, FAQs, and knowledge base.

Once your chatbot is ready in the Nivon AI dashboard, this plugin adds it to your WordPress website without editing theme files or writing code.

Your visitors get answers whenever they need them, and your team spends less time answering the same questions over and over.

✨ What you can do with Nivon

  • 🤖 Answer customer questions: Let your AI chatbot handle common support questions using your own content.
  • 🎯 Capture leads: Collect names, email addresses, and other details from visitors during conversations.
  • 🙋 Connect with your team: Give visitors a way to reach a human when they need more help.
  • 🌍 Support 95+ languages: Help customers write in the language they are most comfortable with.

⚙️ How it works

  1. Create a Nivon account and set up your AI chatbot.
  2. Train your chatbot on your website, documentation, FAQs, or other content.
  3. Copy your publish key and chatbot ID from the Nivon dashboard.
  4. Add both values to the WordPress plugin settings.

That’s it. Your chatbot is now live on your website.

🔗 Useful Links

  • 🚀 Live Demo
  • 🌐 Nivon AI Website
  • 💳 Pricing
  • 📚 Documentation
  • 💬 Support

External Services

This plugin connects to Nivon AI, an AI customer support service operated by Pimjo.

You need a Nivon account and a configured chatbot for the plugin to work. The AI processing and chat functionality are handled by Nivon’s servers.

🔌 What the plugin does

Once you save your publish key and chatbot ID, the plugin loads the Nivon chatbot widget on your website.

The widget runs in your visitor’s browser and communicates with Nivon’s servers when they use the chat.
sections.installation:
🚀 Getting Started

  1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > Nivon Options.
  4. Enter your publish key and chatbot ID.
  5. Click Save Changes.

🔑 Where to find your keys

  1. Log in to your Nivon dashboard.
  2. Open the AI agent you want to use.
  3. Go to the Integration tab.
  4. Copy your publish key and chatbot ID from the script snippet.
  5. Add your WordPress website domain to the chatbot’s allowed domains list.
  6. Paste both values into your WordPress plugin settings.

Your chatbot is now ready to use.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Nivon account?

Yes. This plugin connects your WordPress website to a chatbot created in the Nivon dashboard.

You can 👉 create a free account here.

Is Nivon free?

Nivon has a free plan, with paid plans available if you need more conversations and features.

See 💳 Nivon Pricing for details.

Where do I find my publish key and chatbot ID?

Log in to your Nivon dashboard, open your agent, and go to the Integration tab. You’ll find both values in the script snippet.

My chatbot isn’t showing up. What should I do?

Here are a few things to check:

  • Make sure both your publish key and chatbot ID are saved in Settings > Nivon Options.
  • Check that your website domain is added to the chatbot’s allowed domains list in Nivon.
  • Make sure you copied the correct values from the Integration tab.

Will the chatbot slow down my website?

The widget script loads in the footer with deferred loading, so it does not block page rendering.

Your website’s performance may still vary depending on your theme, hosting, and other plugins.

What does the plugin store on my website?

The plugin stores your publish key and chatbot ID in the WordPress options table. Both values are sanitized before saving.

Can I use Nivon on more than one website?

Yes. You can install the plugin on multiple WordPress websites and connect each one to the chatbot you want to use.

How many languages does Nivon support?

Nivon supports more than 95 languages. Your chatbot can reply in the language your visitor uses.
